column1: # --- ambient light (LIC/LCI) colour library + profiles: BimmerCode / rml.dev names, layout decoded from BimmerCode backups (2026-11-10) ---

column8: Colour index: byte 1 = number of colours (0B = 11); from byte 2 one pair per colour = (first entry, number of entries) into LIC_LCI_COLOR_LIBRARY_DATA; FF = unused. Decoded from BimmerCode backup diffs (2026-11)

Ambient colour library. BimmerCode name shown in the rml.dev g8x-colors tool (2024). Layout (decoded from backups): byte 1 = entry count (1E = 30); then 5-byte entries [zone][R][G][B][flag]; zone 01 = doors & dash, 02 = footwells, 03 = map light; RGB 00-FE (FF is capped to FE). Colour 01 (factory lime) = bytes 18-20 / 23-25 / 28-30 of this function (360A bytes 50-52 / 55-57 / 60-62), the bytes the rml.dev tool writes
factory colour library of G20/G21 with ambient light (4UR); identical to the G28/newer presets. Name from the rml.dev / BimmerCode path, not verified against BMW data
Profiles header: byte 0 = number of profiles (09), byte 1 = colours per profile (02), byte 2 = 03 (meaning unknown). Decoded from BimmerCode backup diffs (2026-11)

Ambient colour profiles (the colours selectable in iDrive). BimmerCode name shown in the rml.dev g8x-colors tool (2024). Layout: one pair of colour indexes into LIC_LCI_COLOR_LIBRARY_DATA per profile (factory: same colour twice, e.g. 01/01 = profile 1 = lime); a different second colour gives a two-tone profile (which zones it drives: unverified)
factory profile list of G20/G21 with ambient light (4UR), identical to the newer presets
